description: KU Leuven and VITO researchers publish typical, extreme-cold and extreme-warm weather years for building-energy simulation at Kortrijk Kennedy Park, Belgium, under a late-century RCP 8.5 climate scenario. Zenodo provides six public EPW and STAT files under CC BY 4.0. The provider says these representative years were selected from 2070–2098 COSMO-CLM simulations at 2.8-kilometre spatial and hourly temporal resolution, with urban canopy treatment and bias correction for temperature, radiation and humidity. The files can test building heating, cooling or retrofit designs against future typical and extreme weather. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this future-climate trio. A limitation is that RCP 8.5 is one scenario, not a probability distribution or forecast for a particular year. Typical and extreme-year selection reduces the full climate series, and the reference list contains an incomplete publication year. The matching recent-past deposit supplies a comparison baseline. No weather file was downloaded or used in a simulator.
